deviations_from_card: Coordinator revisions applied: entry = 'label - headline - time left' (no separate amount; a test asserts the amount appears once); events go through A's emit(); Resume dispatched as main/no token via execute::<serde_json::Value> so a future report return does not break it (Pause now uses the same helper). tray_model takes the snapshot's items slice (&[AttentionItem]) rather than &AttentionSnapshot, so the shell can build it before the first snapshot. Extra cases beyond the card: singular '1 needs you', tooltip 'one overdue'/'next due now', '>= 1 day' -> 'in N d'. Feat commits carry their tests (a test-only commit would not compile / would be red); lib.rs module line committed with the new tray.rs under the lock (lib.rs alone would not compile). No client, binding, authority-table or manifest change.
notes: Red before: 7 tray:: unit tests failed against a stub module; the capabilities source-scan test failed against the old literal-id menu. Shell: DesktopState gains agents_paused (AtomicBool, seeded from setup settings, updated on WalletEvent::Settings and lag recovery) and tray (Mutex<TrayModel>); refresh_tray rebuilds menu+tooltip via run_on_main_thread only when the model changed (attention, settings, 1 s tick). Clicks are answered from the stored model, so a stale Pause/deal click does nothing. open_card() is the one route to tumbler:selected, shared with the toast. Not run: the live app (no dev servers) - native menu rendering, duplicate 'main' id (the 'N more' entry and 'Open The Table' share it) and '&' in menu text are unverified in a real tray. Client suite not run (client untouched). Mishap cleaned: one cargo run used a relative CARGO_TARGET_DIR from src-tauri and created apps/desktop/src-tauri/target + .build (gitignored); both deleted.
